title: U.S. auto industry faces more uncertainty without extension of USMCA trade deal
title_zh: 如果不延长USMCA贸易协议，美国汽车业将面临更多不确定性
text: A major issue for automakers is the deal's rules of origin, which determine where a product comes from and which goods are eligible for preferential treatment.
zh: 汽车制造商面临的一个主要问题是该协议的原产地规则，它决定了产品的来源以及哪些商品有资格获得优惠待遇。

title: Private payrolls rose by 98,000 in June, less than expected, ADP reports
title_zh: ADP报告称，6月份私营部门就业人数增加98,000人，低于预期
text: Companies added slightly fewer workers than forecast, with hiring targeted heavily toward healthcare-related sectors.
zh: 公司新增员工数量略低于预期，招聘主要针对医疗保健相关行业。

title: Trump Accounts for kids launch July 4: What parents need to know
title_zh: 特朗普儿童账户将于 7 月 4 日推出：家长需要了解什么
text: Here's a breakdown of how Trump Accounts work, who qualifies for free money and when the funds can be withdrawn.
zh: 以下详细介绍了特朗普账户的运作方式、谁有资格获得免费资金以及何时可以提取资金。

title: South Korean government discriminated against Coupang, U.S. companies, House report finds
title_zh: 众议院报告发现韩国政府歧视 Coupang 和美国公司
text: The House Judiciary Committee said the South Korean government discriminated against Coupang and other U.S. companies, in a new report.
zh: 众议院司法委员会在一份新报告中表示，韩国政府歧视 Coupang 和其他美国公司。

title: Bulls are betting big on this global ETF that's deep in a bear market
title_zh: 多头在这只深陷熊市的全球 ETF 上押下重注
text: U.S. stocks just keep winning, with the Nasdaq closing out its best quarter since 2020. Across the globe in China, things couldn't be more different.
zh: 美国股市继续上涨，纳斯达克指数结束了 2020 年以来最好的季度。在全球范围内的中国，情况截然不同。

title: More than one-third of employees still work from home, new research shows
title_zh: 新研究显示，超过三分之一的员工仍然在家工作
text: Despite return-to-office policies, the share of employees working from home increased in 2025 from the year before, according to the latest BLS data.
zh: 根据劳工统计局的最新数据，尽管有重返办公室政策，但 2025 年在家工作的员工比例仍较上一年有所增加。

title: Demand for riskier mortgages drops, as their advantages shrink
title_zh: 由于优势缩小，对风险较高的抵押贷款的需求下降
text: The spread between the 30-year fixed-rate mortgage and adjustable-rate loans is narrowing, causing demand for ARMs to weaken.
zh: 30 年期固定利率抵押贷款和可调利率贷款之间的利差正在缩小，导致对 ARM 的需求减弱。

title: Buy the UK DIP? Defense stocks lifted by $20 billion spending boost as gilts come under fire
title_zh: 购买英国DIP？英国国债受到攻击，国防股支出增加 200 亿美元
text: British defense stocks are marching higher once again after the U.K. confirmed a near-$20 billion military spending boost on Tuesday.
zh: 英国周二确认军费开支增加近 200 亿美元后，英国国防股再次走高。

title: We're exiting a troubled stock after a muted quarter, while considering better options
title_zh: 在经历了一个低迷的季度后，我们将退出一只陷入困境的股票，同时考虑更好的选择
text: The quarter offered some signs that management's turnaround strategy is gaining traction, but progress remains slow.
zh: 本季度的一些迹象表明，管理层的扭亏为盈战略正在获得关注，但进展仍然缓慢。

title: Nike results top estimates even as China sales drop 12%; retailer expects $986 million tariff refund
title_zh: 尽管中国销售额下降 12%，耐克业绩仍高于预期；零售商预计获得 9.86 亿美元关税退款
text: Nike was expected to report another quarter of declining sales as the sneaker giant struggles to regain strength under its turnaround strategy.
zh: 耐克预计将报告另一个季度的销售额下降，因为这家运动鞋巨头在其扭亏为盈战略下努力恢复实力。

title: Big egg producers settle price inflation probe with DOJ for 53 million eggs — and $3.3M
title_zh: 大型鸡蛋生产商与司法部就 5300 万枚鸡蛋和 330 万美元的价格通胀调查达成和解
text: Cal-Maine Foods, Versova and Hickman's Egg Ranch agreed to settle allegations of price manipulation by the Department of Justice and 17 states.
zh: Cal-Maine Foods、Versova 和 Hickman's Egg Ranch 同意就司法部和 17 个州的价格操纵指控达成和解。

title: FDA lets Philip Morris market Zyn nicotine pouches as less harmful than cigarettes
title_zh: FDA 允许菲利普莫里斯公司销售 Zyn 尼古丁袋，其危害比香烟低
text: The Trump administration has expanded access to nicotine products despite concerns from public health critics about youth use and addiction.
zh: 尽管公共卫生批评者对青少年使用尼古丁和成瘾表示担忧，但特朗普政府还是扩大了尼古丁产品的获取范围。

title: Private equity in youth sports draws bipartisan scrutiny in Congress
title_zh: 青年体育领域的私募股权在国会受到两党审查
text: Democratic and Republican members of Congress expressed alarm at the trend of private equity investment in youth sports.
zh: 国会民主党和共和党议员对私募股权投资青少年体育的趋势表示担忧。

title: Small cap-focused Russell 2000 becomes first U.S. benchmark to enter correction territory
title_zh: 以小盘股为主的罗素 2000 指数成为首个进入调整区间的美国基准指数
text: Small caps are especially sensitive to changes in oil prices and a slowdown in the economic cycle.
zh: 小盘股对油价变化和经济周期放缓尤其敏感。

title: Fed still expects to cut rates once this year despite spiking oil prices
title_zh: 尽管油价飙升，美联储仍预计今年降息一次
text: The central bank's so-called dot plot showed a median estimate of 3.4% for the federal funds rate, the same as at the end of last year.
zh: 央行所谓的点阵图显示，联邦基金利率的中值为3.4%，与去年年底相同。

title: Tech leads first half stock gains — but the biggest winners weren't in the U.S.
title_zh: 科技股引领上半年股市上涨，但最大的赢家并非在美国
text: U.S. Big Tech stocks enjoyed strong gains — despite a sharp sell-off at the end of June — but were largely outperformed by their international counterparts.
zh: 尽管美国大型科技股在 6 月底遭遇大幅抛售，但仍大幅上涨，但其表现在很大程度上优于国际同行。

title: Oil prices wobble as breakdown in U.S.-Iran talks casts doubt over peace process
title_zh: 美伊谈判破裂引发对和平进程的怀疑，油价波动
text: Oil prices were lower on Wednesday after Iran said it would not meet with U.S. delegates for talks in Qatar, amplifying concern about the peace process.
zh: 伊朗表示不会与美国代表在卡塔尔举行会谈，加剧了人们对和平进程的担忧，周三油价走低。

title: Lamborghini reveals new Urus performance hybrid SUV after ditching EVs
title_zh: 兰博基尼放弃电动汽车后推出新款 Urus 高性能混合动力 SUV
text: Lamborghini is calling the new Urus SE Performante the "fastest Super SUV in the world."
zh: 兰博基尼将新款 Urus SE Performante 称为“世界上最快的超级 SUV”。

title: Gold prices fall further after worst quarter in 13 years as interest rate fears hit bullion
title_zh: 由于利率担忧打击金价，金价在经历13年来最糟糕的季度后进一步下跌
text: Gold fell further on Wednesday, with bullion continuing its slide after suffering its worst quarter since 2013.
zh: 周三金价进一步下跌，在经历了 2013 年以来最糟糕的季度后，金价继续下滑。

title: GOP Rep. Tom Kean says depression diagnosis caused months-long absence from Congress
title_zh: 共和党众议员汤姆·基恩表示，抑郁症诊断导致他缺席国会数月
text: New Jersey Rep. Tom Kean said he was diagnosed with depression, explaining a months-long absence from Congress in a competitive district in the midterm elections.
zh: 新泽西州众议员汤姆·基恩 (Tom Kean) 表示，他被诊断出患有抑郁症，并解释了他在中期选举竞争激烈的选区缺席国会数月的原因。

title: UAE's MGX raises one of the biggest AI funds ever as it closes at $49 billion
title_zh: 阿联酋 MGX 筹集了有史以来最大的人工智能基金之一，募集资金达 490 亿美元
text: The company is a backer of major AI companies including OpenAI and Anthropic, alongside Elon Musk's xAI, prior to its merger with SpaceX.
zh: 在与 SpaceX 合并之前，该公司是包括 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 在内的主要人工智能公司的支持者，以及埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的 xAI。

title: Europe’s defense boom faces a new test: Can it actually deliver weapons?
title_zh: 欧洲的国防繁荣面临新的考验：它真的能运送武器吗？
text: Europe’s defense boom faces a test as investors weigh whether budgets and backlogs can become weapons, factories and returns.
zh: 随着投资者权衡预算和积压是否可以成为武器、工厂和回报，欧洲的国防繁荣面临考验。

title: Supreme Court upholds birthright citizenship, blocks Trump order
title_zh: 最高法院维持出生公民权，阻止特朗普命令
text: President Donald Trump attended oral arguments in the case, underscoring his staunch opposition to granting automatic citizenship to many immigrants' babies.
zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统出席了此案的口头辩论，强调他坚决反对向许多移民婴儿自动授予公民身份。

title: Xi touts China Communist Party's global influence in speech marking 105th anniversary
title_zh: 习近平在庆祝建党105周年讲话中宣扬中国共产党的全球影响力
text: Chinese President Xi Jinping spoke Wednesday to commemorate the 105th anniversary of the ruling Communist Party of China.
zh: 中国国家主席习近平周三发表讲话，纪念中国共产党成立105周年。

title: AWS puts $1 billion into new AI unit to embed engineers with customers, joining growing wave
title_zh: AWS 向新的人工智能部门投入 10 亿美元，让工程师与客户融为一体，加入不断增长的浪潮
text: AWS FDEs will look to leave behind self-sufficient teams with new AI solutions and capabilities in a matter of weeks, the company said.
zh: 该公司表示，AWS FDE 将在几周内留下拥有新的人工智能解决方案和功能的自给自足的团队。

title: Berkshire shares trade lower even after Abel scores good marks at meeting, earnings jump
title_zh: 即使阿贝尔在会议上取得好成绩、盈利大幅增长，伯克希尔股价仍走低
text: Many in the investment community were reassured by Abel's firm grasp over Berkshire's sprawling enterprise.
zh: 阿贝尔对伯克希尔庞大企业的坚定控制让投资界的许多人感到放心。

title: ‘I claimed Social Security at 62’: At 76, I’m working at Walmart. Why do I still owe payroll taxes?
title_zh: “我在 62 岁时领取了社会保障”：76 岁的我在沃尔玛工作。为什么我仍然欠工资税？
text: “It seems like half of the workforce at our local Walmart is over 65.”
zh: “我们当地的沃尔玛似乎有一半员工年龄超过 65 岁。”

title: Is the stock market open on Friday, or will it close early for the Fourth of July?
title_zh: 股市是在周五开市，还是会在 7 月 4 日提早收盘？
text: Since Independence Day falls on Saturday this year, here’s what to know about trading hours and mail delivery
zh: 由于今年的独立日是星期六，因此以下是有关交易时间和邮件投递的信息

title: Anthropic gets all-clear to let foreigners use latest model ahead of crucial IPO
title_zh: Anthropic 在关键的 IPO 之前明确允许外国人使用最新模型
text: News the U.S. government has lifted export controls on Anthropic’s most powerful artificial-intelligence models puts the company back on track to go forward with a critical initial public offering.
zh: 美国政府取消对 Anthropic 最强大的人工智能模型的出口管制的消息使该公司重回正轨，继续进行重要的首次公开募股。

title: Microsoft is reportedly planning thousands of layoffs as it spends on AI
title_zh: 据报道，微软正计划裁员数千人，因为它在人工智能上投入了资金
text: According to a Business Insider report, the tech giant is expected to cut less than 2.5% of its workforce
zh: 据 Business Insider 报道，这家科技巨头预计将裁员不到 2.5%

title: Iran says it is selling oil at 20% premium as end of U.S. blockade sees 40 million barrels exported
title_zh: 伊朗表示，随着美国封锁结束，伊朗石油出口量达到4000万桶，其溢价为20%
text: The ceasefire prompted a surge in crude shipments through the Strait of Hormuz, where traffic had largely ground to a halt during the conflict.
zh: 停火促使霍尔木兹海峡的原油运输量激增，该海峡的交通在冲突期间基本陷入停滞。

title: Employers who laid off workers citing AI are already starting to regret it
title_zh: 以人工智能为由解雇员工的雇主已经开始后悔
text: Companies are realizing artificial intelligence can't do everything after all, prompting them to rehire employees to grow their businesses
zh: 公司意识到人工智能毕竟不能做所有事情，促使他们重新雇用员工来发展业务

title: North Sea oil and renewables: The UK’s next PM faces a defining energy policy decision
title_zh: 北海石油和可再生能源：英国下一任首相面临决定性的能源政策决定
text: Andy Burnham could face an early test over North Sea oil drilling as energy shocks revive the UK energy security debate.
zh: 随着能源冲击重新引发英国能源安全辩论，安迪·伯纳姆可能面临北海石油钻探的早期考验。

title: CNBC Daily Open: Anthropic unbound, Trump's finances and crude realities
title_zh: CNBC 每日开盘：人类的自由、特朗普的财务状况和残酷的现实
text: AI giant Anthropic has been cleared to redeploy models after the Trump administration lifts export controls.
zh: 在特朗普政府取消出口管制后，人工智能巨头 Anthropic 已获准重新部署模型。

title: Japan spent $74 billion propping up the yen. Investors say the real battle is with the Fed
title_zh: 日本花费740亿美元支撑日元。投资者称真正的战斗是与美联储
text: Yen intervention alone is unlikely to reverse losses while wide U.S.-Japan rate differentials keep supporting the dollar, said analysts.
zh: 分析师表示，仅靠日元干预不太可能扭转损失，而美日利差的巨大差距继续支撑美元。

title: KKR to control South Korea's $1.3 billion renewables platform with SK as AI power demand rises
title_zh: 随着人工智能电力需求的增长，KKR 将与 SK 共同控制韩国价值 13 亿美元的可再生能源平台
text: The announcement came after South Korea announced on Monday three massive investment projects, spanning semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers.
zh: 此前，韩国周一宣布了三个大规模投资项目，涵盖半导体、物理人工智能和人工智能数据中心。

title: LNG market disruption may continue for months as a top producer withholds some Italian shipments
title_zh: 由于一家顶级生产商扣留了部分意大利发货，液化天然气市场混乱可能会持续数月
text: QatarEnergy extended its force majeure, withholding four additional LNG cargoes until September, as damage from the war prolongs supply constraints.
zh: 由于战争造成的损害延长了供应限制，卡塔尔能源公司延长了不可抗力期限，扣押了另外四批液化天然气货物，直至 9 月份。

title: Trump's massive defense budget, depleted war machine, spark U.S. state battle for business and jobs
title_zh: 特朗普庞大的国防预算、耗尽的战争机器引发了美国各州的商业和就业之争
text: Trump's huge defense budget request and a race to replenish weapons stocks while building hypersonic missiles lead to war between U.S. states for jobs.
zh: 特朗普巨额国防预算要求以及在制造高超音速导弹的同时补充武器库存的竞赛导致了美国各州之间的就业战争。

title: CNBC Daily Open: AI demand fuels investors' portfolios while oil posts biggest monthly decline
title_zh: CNBC 每日开盘：人工智能需求推动投资者投资组合，而石油月度跌幅最大
text: The tech space continues to be fueled by rising artificial intelligence demand, with investors piling their portfolios in the technology, while Amazon Web Services dabbles with Forward Deployed Engineering units to better compete with OpenAI and Anthropic.
zh: 不断增长的人工智能需求继续推动科技领域发展，投资者纷纷在该技术领域投入大量投资，而亚马逊网络服务则涉足前向部署工程部门，以更好地与 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 竞争。

title: Who ate all the Chinese stock market returns? - Financial Times
title_zh: 中国股市的收益全部被谁吃掉了？ - 金融时报
text: Who ate all the Chinese stock market returns? Financial Times
zh: 中国股市的收益全部被谁吃掉了？金融时报

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq retreat as tech leads market lower, banks slide after earnings - Yahoo Finance
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克指数因科技股引领市场走低而下跌，银行股在财报公布后下滑 - 雅虎财经
text: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq retreat as tech leads market lower, banks slide after earnings Yahoo Finance
zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克指数因科技股引领市场走低而下跌，银行股在财报公布后下滑 雅虎财经

title: From the US to China, 2025 a blockbuster year for stock markets - Al Jazeera
title_zh: 从美国到中国，2025 年是股市重磅之年 - 半岛电视台
text: From the US to China, 2025 a blockbuster year for stock markets Al Jazeera
zh: 从美国到中国，2025 年是股市重磅之年

title: China’s economic policy holds line as growth weakens - Mercator Institute for China Studies (MERICS)
title_zh: 随着增长放缓，中国经济政策保持不变 - 墨卡托中国研究中心 (MERICS)
text: China’s economic policy holds line as growth weakens Mercator Institute for China Studies (MERICS)
zh: 随着经济增长疲软，中国经济政策保持不变 墨卡托中国研究中心 (MERICS)

title: China’s private funds see assets soar by over US$400 billion amid tech boom - South China Morning Post
title_zh: 科技繁荣，中国私募基金资产飙升逾4000亿美元 - 《南华早报》
text: China’s private funds see assets soar by over US$400 billion amid tech boom South China Morning Post
zh: 《南华早报》：随着科技繁荣，中国私募基金资产飙升逾4000亿美元

title: China’s Role in the USMCA Review - Baker Institute
title_zh: 中国在 USMCA 审查中的作用 - Baker Institute
text: China’s Role in the USMCA Review Baker Institute
zh: 中国在 USMCA 审查中的作用 Baker Institute

title: Anthropic says Trump admin has lifted export controls on Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5
title_zh: Anthropic 表示特朗普政府已取消对《克劳德寓言 5》和《神话 5》的出口管制
text: The U.S. Department of Commerce lifted the export controls on Anthropic's Fable 5 and Mythos 5 models
zh: 美国商务部取消对 Anthropic 的《神鬼寓言 5》和《神话 5》机型的出口管制

title: China-linked actors target more than technology as AI competition with U.S. intensifies
title_zh: 随着与美国的人工智能竞争加剧，与中国相关的参与者的目标不仅仅是技术
text: Cyberattacks from China-based entities are on the rise and not just targeting specific tech, analysts warn, as the U.S. AI race intensifies.
zh: 分析师警告称，随着美国人工智能竞赛的加剧，来自中国实体的网络攻击正在增加，而且不仅仅针对特定技术。

title: Do you really, really love your job? Then you're not alone, according to surprising results from this survey
title_zh: 你真的、真的热爱你的工作吗？根据这项调查的令人惊讶的结果，你并不孤单
text: Those surveyed showed a 78.9% rate of workers who "reported feeling positive at the end of their shifts."
zh: 受访者显示，78.9% 的员工“表示在轮班结束时感觉积极”。

title: Jim Cramer says the AI trade has shifted — and these stocks are leading now
title_zh: 吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 表示，人工智能行业已经发生转变，这些股票现在处于领先地位
text: CNBC's Jim Cramer said Wall Street is rewarding the companies supplying the artificial intelligence boom rather than the technology giants funding it.
zh: CNBC 的吉姆·克莱默 (Jim Cramer) 表示，华尔街正在奖励那些为人工智能热潮提供支持的公司，而不是为其提供资金的科技巨头。

title: After a soft Nike quarter, we have a big decision to make on the stock
title_zh: 在经历了疲软的耐克季度之后，我们对股票做出了重大决定
text: The results are unlikely to improve Nike's standing in the portfolio
zh: 结果不太可能提高耐克在产品组合中的地位

title: Why Asia still struggles to create its own mega-IPOs like SpaceX
title_zh: 为什么亚洲仍然难以创建像 SpaceX 这样自己的大型 IPO
text: Asia has no shortage of entrepreneurs, engineers or giant domestic markets. Yet when it comes to producing the kind of blockbuster listings seen in the U.S., the region continues to lag.
zh: 亚洲不缺乏企业家、工程师或巨大的国内市场。然而，当谈到生产美国那样的重磅上市时，该地区仍然落后。

title: Brent posts biggest monthly decline since March 2020 as traders monitor U.S.-Iran talks
